comment: This is our own plugin and everything above comes from its source. The module has no parameters, inputs or outputs at all, so nothing on it can be clicked for help except the title band, which is why every fact is a Note. The thirteen panel rows are drawn by one custom widget, ControlColumn, with no ParamWidget per row, so they are unreachable by a click for help even though they can be pressed. The six menu item names are the literal strings passed to createMenuItem and createBoolPtrMenuItem in DemoWidget::appendContextMenu.
